gaps.sentence: If the pilot ___ the storm, we would have landed on time.
gaps.explanation: The unreal past condition takes the past perfect: had avoided.

gaps.sentence: I wish I ___ so much cake — I feel sick now.
gaps.hint: past act with a present consequence
gaps.explanation: The regret is about a past action, so 'wish' takes the past perfect: had not eaten.

gaps.sentence: You ___ the truth if you had asked me directly.
gaps.hint: a passive result in the third conditional
gaps.explanation: The third-conditional result clause can be passive: would have been told.

gaps.sentence: You will not pass the course unless you ___ all the assignments.
gaps.hint: unless means if not, present simple
gaps.explanation: 'Unless' introduces a negative condition and takes the present simple: complete.

gaps.sentence: If you had set an alarm, you ___.
gaps.explanation: The present result of a past unreal condition takes 'would not be': would not still be asleep.

gaps.sentence: If only I ___ more free time these days.
gaps.hint: if only plus past, present wish
gaps.explanation: 'If only' works like 'wish' and takes the past simple for present regrets: had.

gaps.sentence: I will note the reference number in case I ___ it later.
gaps.hint: in case means as a precaution
gaps.explanation: 'In case' describes a precaution and takes the present simple: need.

gaps.sentence: If you ___ me, I would have helped you move house.
gaps.hint: a missed request in the past
gaps.explanation: An unreal past condition takes the past perfect: had asked.
